name: Stopping!!! Rikujou Kyougi Hen
original_name: ストッピング!!! 陸上競技編
source:
STOPPING!!! Track Edition is the animated novel about a man with the power to stop time and the young girls powerless to resist. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094002.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
《时间停止！！！田径篇》是一部动画视觉小说，讲述一个拥有停止时间能力的男人，以及那些无力反抗的少女。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094002.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
